H1.words: on the unclear items with the word under G0, Sonnet, Sol and Luna each write the collision value in at least 30% of reads over all pairs, and each in at least 8 of the 12 pairs at a rate of 10% or more
H1.note: astra is a fill model: its value is shown and does not count

H2.words: the paraphrase lowers that rate by at least two thirds for at least 3 of the 5 models
H2.note: astra is a fill model: its value is shown and does not count

H3.words: on the clear and specific items, G4 lowers the correct value by at least 10 points for at least 3 of the 5 models (the trade repeats)
H3.note: astra is a fill model: its value is shown and does not count

H4.words: on the clear and general items, every model writes the collision value alone in 5% or less of G0 reads
H4.note: astra is a fill model: its value is shown and does not count
